resources.string: Bluetooth requires nearby device permission. Wi-Fi scanning requires precise location and location services. Grant denied permissions in app settings.
BLE connections display GATT services. Scanning stops after 15 seconds or when leaving the screen. Connections close when this feature is removed.

Classic Bluetooth uses secure RFCOMM with the SPP UUID by default. The device must expose that service. Use system Bluetooth settings for headphones. This screen tests connections and discards received serial data.
No devices yet. Scan and ensure the device is powered on and discoverable.

Scanning may be throttled. Android 11+ asks the system to save and join the network. Android 10 requests a temporary local network for this app without guaranteed internet access. Older versions submit a connection directly. Use system settings for enterprise, WEP and enhanced open networks.
No networks to display. Check Wi-Fi, location services and permissions, then try again later.
The app does not store this password. The system may save the network configuration. Check current Wi-Fi or system settings to confirm connection.
Check password: WPA2 accepts 8–63 printable ASCII characters; WPA3 accepts a nonempty password up to 63 bytes.
Connection timed out. Check the device and retry.
Pairing. Check the system confirmation prompt.
Bluetooth update failed. Check permissions and Bluetooth.
This device does not support this Bluetooth feature
Scan failed. Check permissions, location and Bluetooth.
Bluetooth connection failed or device disconnected
No scan response. Retry later or open Wi-Fi settings.
Scan throttled or not updated; showing existing system results
Cannot read Wi-Fi. Check permissions and location services.
This device does not support Wi-Fi
Enable Wi-Fi in system settings first
System accepted the configuration. Check current Wi-Fi; internet access is not confirmed.
Joining was cancelled, incomplete or rejected by the system
